interface.title: Interface
interface.titleDesc: Tweak settings related to the user interface.
interface.openBehaviorDesc: Choose what happens when opening another workspace.
interface.interfaceFontDesc: Font used for Yaak interface controls.
interface.editorFontDesc: Font used in request and response editors.
interface.keymapDesc: Keyboard shortcut preset used by text editors.
interface.softWrapDesc: Wrap long lines in request and response editors.
interface.coloredMethodsDesc: Use method-specific colors for HTTP request methods.
interface.hideWindowControlsDesc: Hide the close, maximize, and minimize controls on Windows or Linux.
interface.nativeTitlebarDesc: Use the operating system's standard title bar and window controls.
interface.hideBadgeDesc: Hide the personal-use badge from the interface.
